{{Quote|General, we've been outflanked.|The droid speaking to Grievous|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous's frigate/Legends|Grievous's ''Munificent''-class star frigate]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]]. During the space battle, this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] informed Grievous that the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] had been outflanked by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]]. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s was then destroyed along with the rest of the Separatist fleet when the AT-TEs opened fire on the exposed sterns of the ships. However, [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] managed to escape in [[Soulless One/Legends|his starfighter]].

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] being a B1 battle droid may be an animation error. This is because of where it is placed in the battle at the right of Grievous. As seen in [[Downfall of a Droid]] [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]] can be distinguished from regular B1 battle droids by, in addition to some blue [[Color/Legends|coloring]], darker lines on their head and several small marks on their head. A battle droid that appears to possess these darker lines is to the right of Grievous during the Battle of Bothawui, and so this would seem to be a [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]], but later in the scene the animation has changed it to this B1.
